title: AtumEscrowExtra
description: The `extra.atum` object carried inside an atum-escrow x402 PaymentRequirements entry (accepts[]): the merchant's receive-side plus the contract/role addresses and deadline budgets. Scheme-specific data the standard x402 `extra` bag treats as opaque, so it is owned here and shared by all role mechanisms. Addresses are chain-general: an EVM `0x`-hex address (20 bytes) a base58-encoded address (Solana/Tron), or a Stellar strkey (a `G...` account or `C...` contract), per the field's CAIP-2 chain.

destination.description: Where the merchant receives (CAIP-2 chain, token, address).

asset.description: Destination token contract address (EVM hex, base58 or a Stellar strkey, per the destination chain).

address.description: Merchant receive address (EVM hex, base58 or a Stellar strkey, per the destination chain).

fulfillmentAmount.description: Exact amount the merchant receives, in atomic token units.

escrow.description: Source-chain escrow contract (the x402 payTo); EVM hex, base58 or a Stellar strkey, per the source chain.

fulfillmentProxy.description: Destination-chain fulfillment proxy contract (EVM hex, base58 or a Stellar strkey, per the destination chain).

reserver.description: Atum reserver role address (escrow deposit witness); EVM hex, base58 or a Stellar strkey, per the source chain.

releaser.description: Atum releaser role address (escrow deposit witness); EVM hex, base58 or a Stellar strkey, per the source chain.

fulfillmentVerifierEndpoint.description: Source-chain fulfillment-verifier endpoint the payment request carries. The verifier account and the quote_selector are the releaser and reserver respectively (the network derives the deposit witness roles from them), so only the endpoint is not otherwise present in this object.

quoteDeadlineSeconds.description: Recommended quote-deadline budget in seconds, relative to signing time.

fulfillmentDeadlineSeconds.description: Recommended fulfillment-deadline budget in seconds, relative to signing time.

svmSignatureClusterId.description: Solana source only: cluster name used to build the 32-byte cluster_id in the V3 escrow signature domain. Optional; the facilitator requires it for a Solana source.

svmSignatureDomainVersion.description: Solana source only: escrow signature-domain version (V3 domain separation). Optional; required for a Solana source.

depositRequestHashVersions.description: The depositRequestHash versions the payer may sign for this source: 1 is keccak256 of the request_id, 2 is the hash of the payment terms. Absent means [1]. A client signs 2 when the list contains it and 1 otherwise. A client or facilitator that predates this field refuses a requirement carrying it, even [1], so a resource server publishes it only once its payers and its facilitator run a release that knows it, and lists 2 only once the payment gateway's GET /v1/defaults returns deposit_request_hash_version 2 for the source chain, the network-wide signal that every reader of the deposit reads version 2.
